topic: Private location can't resolve internal hostnames
environment: Internal services with private DNS names
symptom_pattern: API tests against internal services fail from the private location with a DNS error (ENOTFOUND), while curl from the same host resolves the name fine.
root_cause: The worker is configured to skip the host resolver (dnsUseHost false) and only query public DNS servers, which don't know internal names.
resolution_path: Check the test result's error type (DNS)
Review dnsUseHost / dnsServer in the worker config
Use the host resolver or add the internal DNS server to dnsServer
info_needed: how the host resolves the name

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the worker config, with the keys removed?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It has dnsUseHost: false and dnsServer [8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1]; the network team wanted no dependency on the host.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Does nslookup of the target work from the host?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, it resolves to a 10.x address.

customer_style.tone: network engineer, confident the problem is in Datadog
